metadata.title: Capgo vs Voltbuilder
metadata.description: Voltbuilder builds store-ready Cordova apps in the cloud. Capgo adds Capacitor live updates — compare scope and read the full Voltbuilder alternative post.

blocks.text: For teams that turn a web project into store-ready Android and iOS apps. VoltBuilder builds the binaries; Capgo builds them too and keeps shipping web changes after the app is live.
Choose VoltBuilder if you only need store builds. Choose Capgo if you want native builds plus live updates, channels, and rollback after release.
14-day unlimited free trial. No credit card required.
Capgo vs VoltBuilder at a glance
Capgo vs VoltBuilder, as of September 2026. Each VoltBuilder fact links to a numbered source listed below the table.

Indy $15/month ($150/year), Pro $37/month ($370/year), Enterprise on request. Free tier for Android debug builds. 15-day free trial.
Ships JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and asset changes without waiting for store review, with delta downloads and end-to-end encryption. 1B+ updates per month.
Not offered. The VoltBuilder docs cover builds, signing, store upload, and hosting, not live updates.
Capgo Builder builds and signs iOS and Android binaries in the cloud, typically in 2–3 minutes, and can upload them to the stores. Build time is included in plans.
Upload a zip and get store-ready Android and iOS builds, with upload to Google Play and App Store Connect. No Mac required.
Capacitor apps built with React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Ionic, or any web framework. Live updates also work for Cordova and Electron. Not for React Native.
Updater plugin and Capgo plugins are free under MPL-2.0. Backend source is on GitHub under AGPL-3.0. Run your own update server, or use licensed self-hosting on Enterprise.
Hosted build service. VoltBuilder deletes passwords, certificates, and source code after each build.
Dynamic channels, device and channel overrides, progressive rollouts, automatic rollback when a bundle fails to start, and one-click revert to a previous bundle.
Not applicable without live updates. Every change ships as a new store build.
Discord and email with the engineers who build Capgo. Priority plugin fixes on any plan, and Premium Support for production deadlines.
Email at support@volt.build and a community forum.

Where VoltBuilder is the better choice
No tool fits every team. These are the cases where we would point you to the other option.
VoltBuilder is a build service only. If you ship every change through the stores and never need live updates, it covers the job.
Your app is a Cordova project
VoltBuilder supports Cordova projects and says you can extend apps with over a thousand Apache Cordova plugins.
You need free Android debug builds
The free VoltBuilder tier builds Android debug apps, 4 builds a day with uploads up to 10 MB.
Add Capgo to a VoltBuilder project
You can keep VoltBuilder for builds and add Capgo live updates, or move builds to Capgo Builder as well.
